name: Wilderflight

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: Disorienting Grenades
perks.desc:
Detonation has a brief disorienting effect. 
  •  Greatly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

perks.name: Spike Grenades
perks.desc:
Grenades fired from this weapon do increased damage on direct hits.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Concussion Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon emit a blast that staggers enemies.

perks.name: Black Powder
perks.desc:
This weapon's explosives are more effective.
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Blast Distributor
perks.desc: Dealing splash damage grants a bonus to Grenade stat.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.desc: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Reverberation
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for a short duration.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.desc: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Danger Zone
perks.desc: The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Reaper's Tithe
perks.desc: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.desc: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.desc: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Tex Balanced Stock
perks.desc: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Gravity Well
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon automatically gathers nearby ammo.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 139 from 13 May 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0m6Sfdv88fNZmYm9A6PdVR?si=140d643338154357) with @ImpetusAlways @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for damage against Majors and Bosses in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. The original double-fire grenade launch Wilderflight returns with refreshed perks. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are in-band - d2foundry.gg calculates that 93 Velocity equates to 65.31m/s, 20 Stability is ×1.1000 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 43 Handling is 0.43s ready, 0.42s ADS and 0.39s stow speed, 32 Reload Speed is a 2.62s reload, Recoil Direction is 25, and Zoom is 13. With 0/1/2/3 reserves, total ammo is 21/22/23/23 (max 23). For barrel perk choices, look for something that improves Handling and Velocity. Then, for controlling enemy crowds - from Minor adds and Elites, through to Minibosses and Champions (but not Bosses), Disorienting Grenades as the magazine perk is still very powerful, particularly with the increased effect radius from the dual grenades. To pair with that, in the first trait perk column, Slideshot is the top pick as, as well as reloading it also procs Gravity Well to collect nearby ammo bricks. Auto-Loading Holster is also available, but its reload effect doesn't work with Gravity Well. You'll need direct hits to damage enemies, as Disorientating Grenades reduces Blast Radius to 0, but Destabilizing Rounds can spread volatility in groups, or Frenzy does boost damage by ×1.15 as well as maxing out Handling and Reload Speed by being in combat. The Tex Balanced Stock is there if you like hipfiring, but the Gravity Well origin trait can be very useful to pick up ammo bricks within 5m on a manual reload, or using Slideshot (other reload perks don't seem to work, unfortunately). Recommended MW: Handling, with a Quick Access sling mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

The original double-fire grenade launch Wilderflight returns with refreshed perks. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are in-band - d2foundry.gg calculates that 93 Velocity equates to 65.31m/s, 20 Stability is ×1.1000 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 43 Handling is 0.43s ready, 0.42s ADS and 0.39s stow speed, 32 Reload Speed is a 2.62s reload, Recoil Direction is 25, and Zoom is 13. With 0/1/2/3 reserves, total ammo is 21/22/23/23 (max 23). For barrel perk choices, look for something that improves Handling and Velocity. Then, for the magazine perk for damage against beefier enemies, Spike Grenades increases impact damage by ×1.1212, which is ×1.025 to overall damage. To pair with that, in the first trait perk column, Slideshot is the top pick as, as well as reloading it also procs Gravity Well to collect nearby ammo bricks. Auto-Loading Holster and Envious Arsenal are also very usable, but their reload effects don't work with Gravity Well. For damage, Bait and Switch in the second column boosts damage by ×1.3 for rotating through your weapons and hitting enemies. The Tex Balanced Stock is there if you like hipfiring, but the Gravity Well origin trait can be very useful to pick up ammo bricks within 5m on a manual reload, or using Slideshot (other reload perks don't seem to work, unfortunately). Recommended MW: Handling, with a Quick Access Sling mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Wilderflight was the first of its kind and having a re-issue definitely feels nice! The new perk pool is stacked with options for every scenario: damage rotation? It has Envious Arsenal and Bait and Switch. Need Void buffs and debuffs? Repulsor Brace and Destabilizing Rounds (or Withering Gaze) have you covered. Its Reload is a bit sluggish, so unless you have a perk that bypasses that, put some investment there; otherwise, blast radius can help it reach more enemies with its double fire intrinsic." Recommended MW: Blast Radius or Reload Speed

warlockmaggie (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "PvP is not the place for this archetype, but there are those who will still try... There's a few options that might work. I could definitely see Withering Gaze being the best option for PvP as you don't need to do anything other than ADS for a short time to proc a 7.5% incoming damage debuff against targets it hits. And that's it, that's all I can say for PvP... *(seriously, why?!?)*" Recommended MW: Blast Radius or Handling
Speedrunner's Shopping List: "Blinding enemies/Filling ranged swap rotation" (good for: all S21 raids and dungeons)

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Wilderflight is an incredibly unique weapon. Similar to Warden’s Law it fires two grenades at once. This does mean that the grenades can split off and you’d only be doing half damage. The double grenades do have two impact damages which does put them ahead of regular grenade launchers. Auto-loading holster is still the best for fire-and-forget. Disruption break is always going to be a strong pick, especially on impacts for demolishing shields. Frenzy and vorpal can work if you’re primarily going to be using Wilderflight as your main source of damage instead of setting up yourself or your team for kinetic damage." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "I don’t know how to feel about Wilderflight in PvP. Technically you can do more damage with double impact, and have some forgiveness with proximity grenades. But it also means that the architecture can really mess you up if you go to bounce shot and it splits the grenades into two different directions. I have yet to fully test out the full damage of each grenade, but disruption break will still probably be then play. Being able to hit one grenade and break a shield will give your kinetic 50% more damage which will definitely drop any guardian with ease." Recommended MW - Blast Radius.
